title: The Peaceful Kingdom
traveler_why: Tonight is a world where nothing hurts and everyone is safe, and Willow the Warm is the Traveler who makes peace rather than waiting for it — she steps into the fuss and hands both children a turn.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she loves to make peace and help everyone feel safe. In Willow’s world today: at the park, a big kid and a little kid were both grabbing the same swing and starting to fuss. Willow gently said, “You can both have a turn — I’ll help count!” Soon they were laughing together. Just like Isaiah’s peaceful world where the lamb and lion are friends, Willow helped make a little pocket of peace.
